shots.detail_en: Suspense hook: in total black a porcelain bowl smashes on the floor — the sound arrives before the image.
shots.sub: 满仓爹（画外）：不碍事……牙口不好，咬滑了……
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Man Cang's home: porridge bowl in shards across the floor, the old father slumped at the table edge, trembling hands picking up pieces.
shots.sub: 满仓：爹！别动——
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Man Cang steadies his father and sees the cracked, tooth-gap old dentures in the old man's mouth.
shots.sub: 满仓爹：裂了好，裂了省心——省得咬着排骨，还想着排骨。
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Red-eyed, Man Cang pulls the passbook from under his father's pillow; tucked inside, a dental clinic price sheet folded and refolded.
shots.sub: 满仓：爹，报价单您揣了半年？咱装牙去——钱不是回来了吗！
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: The father's gaze goes blank, turning to his son.
shots.sub: 满仓爹：钱不是……还在陆先生那儿生息吗？你上个月说的。
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Man Cang freezes, crushing the price sheet into a ball in his palm.
Four-beat mental flashback: old Zhou crumpled on the steps / the pushed-back deposit slip / Hongli's trembling half-sentence / father's cracked dentures.
Man Cang storms out into the rain.
shots.sub: 满仓：陆长虹——！！
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Blast point: in the trading hall, Man Cang slams his father's iron box on Changhong's desk; the lid springs open, deposit slips scatter across the table.
shots.sub: 满仓：一口新牙，一副金镯子，六万块本金——你告诉我，哪一样在账上？！
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Changhong stares at the scattered slips, the topmost marked 'Wang's father — retirement'; Man Cang cuts him off.
shots.sub: 长：满仓，听我说—— 满（打断）：我把身家全仓给你那天，你说这钱是干净的！
shots.speaker: CH+MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Changhong slides over the new deposit slip — principal plus interest.
shots.sub: 长：本金一分没动。它替我们挡过一次砸盘——回来的时候，多了三成。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Man Cang stares at him, tears falling, voice dropping softer instead.
shots.sub: 满仓：长虹，我爹等利息？他等的是一口牙。你账上翻红了每一格——哪一格，是牙？
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Changhong opens his mouth — for once, no candlestick metaphor comes.
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: At the hall entrance, Hongli stands soaked in the rain, holding a yellowed 1993 ledger sheet.
shots.sub: 红：让他把这句答完。答不完的——我替我爹，替陆叔叔，一起问。
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Hongli walks in and lays the 1993 sheet on top of the deposit slips — two eras of ledgers stacked together.
shots.sub: 红：十年前一个雨夜，陆叔叔在我家喝完最后一壶酒，说了半句话。我爹守了十年——今天，原话还你。
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Hongli delivers word by word, tears shining, voice made of ice — the rupture line detonates.
shots.sub: 红：你父亲跳下去之前——最怕的，就是你变成现在这样。
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Mirror-abyss: Changhong staggers half a step, red-green storm churning on the board behind; in the darkened glass screen his silhouette overlaps Xiong Tiancheng's for an instant (the act's heaviest frame).
Hongli lays down the spare staff badge she once lent him (EP02 callback).
shots.sub: 红：账，我还清了。陆长虹——从今天起，你的账，我不再替你圆。
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Man Cang closes the iron box and holds it to his chest, not smiling for the first time.
shots.sub: 满仓：钱我拿走。王满仓这辈子最后一仓——替我爹收着。
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: The emptied hall: Changhong stands alone, three objects left on the table — the 1993 sheet, the new deposit slip, the staff badge.
shots.sub: 旁白：那天我赢了所有数字——账是红的，人走空了。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Across the street inside a car, Xiong Wei watches it all; the 'Achilles' folder pops an alert.
shots.sub: 熊伟：软肋断开。模型建议：加注——他现在，只剩一座山顶可去。
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Rainy night: Changhong presses the pocket watch to his ear — it has stopped, frozen at the one-minute-slow mark.
shots.sub: 爸……表停了。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: 1993 study flashback: father hands the freshly wound pocket watch to twelve-year-old Changhong.
shots.sub: 父：慢一分钟——让它替你记着：市场，永远快你一步。
shots.speaker: FATHER

shots.detail_en: Black frame end card for next episode.
shots.sub: 山顶的电梯只等最后一位客人——按下按钮的那只手，姓熊。
shots.card: 山顶的电梯只等最后一位客人——按下按钮的那只手，姓熊。
